newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Airways Corp yr profit after tax NZ$848,000.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Airways Corp yr profit after tax NZ$848,000.

text.p: New Zealand state-owned enterprise Airways Corporation on Monday reported an after-tax profit for the 1995/96 year of NZ$848,000, against NZ$5.3 million the previous year.

Chairman John Maasland said Airways had exceeded its cost of capital target of NZ$5.8 million, and paid dividends to shareholders of $11.2 million. At the same time, it maintained the lower prices for Airways services introduced last year.
"In terms of reaching its objectives, Airways had a strong performance," Maasland said.
Airways is the first SOE to adopt Economic Value Added (EVA) principles of financial management and reporting.

"We're returning past profits to the customers through lower prices and therefore that affects the bottom line. That's kind of difficult to measure in conventional accounting terms," manager of finance Stuart Wilson told Reuters.
